name: stacked-meter
title: Stacked Meter
description: A capacity bar split into labelled parts, like storage by file type, with a legend that highlights each part and shows the free space.

props.name: segments
props.description: Parts in order, drawn from the strongest tone to the quietest.

props.name: max
props.description: Capacity the bar represents. Defaults to the sum of the parts, so the bar is full.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats values in the legend and summary.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; the text summary starts with it.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the bar in px.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
